searchText: I think it only has recent history? In the insights section I can see it tracking days, and months, or maybe i misunderstood your specifications https://watchtheburn.com/insights I believe it has history up to the start of eip 1559 Ah, I forgot about the insights page. Would be nice if I could adjust the time window and bar size, but this is very helpful. I guess I can at least do hour, day, month bucket sizes. Would be nice to be able to see hour buckets over a week, or 6 hour buckets over several months. The goal being to be able to detect things like intra-day seasonality across months. Like is there a dip at a certain time most days, or on a certain day of the week most weeks. Hmmm i might have seen something like that, but not so sure. I figure this might be something like a dashboard you can create in dune analytics as well if you're up for it I don't have the time/willpower to do such things these days. 😬 I barely had the time/energy to ask my original question. 😛
